scientific.integrity: The proof is an exact termwise inequality for \(\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor/n\), followed by an exact defect-budget and congruence classification. A finite enumeration was used only as a sanity check and not as evidence for the infinite statement.
limitations: The bound is sharp for the numerical condition \(\delta(\pi)\le\chi\); existence of an elliptic surface realizing every equality pattern for every \(\chi\) is not claimed.
The result does not determine semiampleness or the Mori-dream property of every numerically extremal configuration.

The initiating preprint's full PDF was not available through the accessible public full-text route; the primary abstract, bibliographic record, a detailed full-paper secondary review, and the predecessor's public full text were inspected, leaving a residual originality risk for an unindexed equivalent remark.

title: Sharp reducible-fiber envelope in the polyhedral range
